name: Fukuma Masamichi
source:
Employee of Far East Costume Rentals.

The only son of company president Shigemichi Fukuma, he is one of the few people who know what Shigemichi looks like, as his father is usually clad in a rabbit costume. Masamichi has harbored a strong dislike for both his father and mascot costumes ever since the old man showed up at school on Parents' Day one year dressed in his inevitable rabbit suit. Nonetheless, the son has acquiesced to his father's wishes, and some day he'll inherit the family business.

[Edited from in-game TIPS]
